caption:
Reddit mods are really trying to gatekeep the future. The opensource group just said no to AI, solo builders, and non-English speakers all at once. Naturally, people already made a rival group called trueopensource. 💀

Would you stay in a club that keeps changing the rules just to lock everyone out?

Source: The Verge

#Reddit #OpenSource #ArtificialIntelligence #TechNews #CommunityBuilding

post.news: Reddit's opensource community banned any projects involving AI and told non-English speakers to find another group.
post.take: Nothing says community spirit like banning most of the world and the exact thing everyone is building.
post.insight: When mods try to turn the clock back, they usually just create a brand new rival community by breakfast.
